body: research/TASK_J3.md. Top tier, effort high, Fast off. The operator asked for a study that thinks ahead: find the decisions before the build hits them. Four areas - the championship picture (including whether boxing's sanctioning bodies are a fourth pathway on top of your J2 three), the commission layer (medical suspensions are the big one - the game has a fight camp and no reason a fighter cannot fight again next week), the weigh-in, and fighter pay past the purse for the 13 promotions J2 did not cover. Close it with a priority ruling: which to do next, which can wait a year. Same UNKNOWN discipline as J1 and J2.
